static_traits.name: Fang Jie
static_traits.social_status: 有少数亲密朋友，但难以就Loneliness与羞怯向其敞开；离婚后Interpersonal relationships受损，建立新连接困难
static_traits.medical_history: 长期在社交场合经历羞怯与孤立；此前not yet接受针对该问题的治疗；No major physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己的羞怯让人们not愿与我交谈，导致Loneliness与被隔离的感受。
basic_info.core_demands: Recently divorced与愈发强烈的Loneliness感促使我寻求咨询，以应对羞怯并改善社交互动。
growth_experiences: Since childhood, long experiencing shyness and isolation in social settings; despite some career success, still often feels disconnected from others and finds interaction difficult in work and community activities, gradually forming experiences of self-doubt and low self-worth.
Recently divorced后，Interpersonal relationships受到显著影响，Loneliness感与隔离感加重，建立新的人际连接更加困难；在工作场合与社区活动中更频繁体验被回避与not被理解的感受，同时更难向现有朋友敞开。

core_beliefs: do not人not愿意接纳我（not想与我说话）

special_situations.event: 某个项目表现not佳后，回想失败并难以启动新项目
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果项目失败，就证明我就是失败者；成功与失败是非黑即白的，要么行要么not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids starting new projects, reduces attempts to avoid failing again; frequently ruminates on failure experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 项目not做好就证明I am just a failure

special_situations.event: 在工作和社区活动的社交场合，他人not yet主动与我聊天
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我很羞怯，人们就not愿意跟我说话；他人的沉默等于not喜欢我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 勉强自己主动开口，但同时减少深入交流以避免Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not愿跟我说话，因为我太害羞

special_situations.event: 与朋友谈及项目not佳后反复寻求评价，朋友表现出not耐烦
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果朋友not给肯定，就说明我的工作很差、I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断向朋友寻求外部肯定与安慰来缓解not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他觉得我not行、我应该更信任自己但我做not到

special_situations.event: 回顾以往的成功项目时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果有成功，那只是运气，not能代表我的能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正向证据，继续聚焦失败以维持自我叙事一致性

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized, build stable and close connections, and at the same time prove self-worth professionally
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与Being rejected导致自我价值被negate；害怕他人的评判与not耐烦
defense_goal: 通过寻求外部认可来暂时稳定自我价值
减少尝试或回避新项目以降低失败与羞耻的风险
在社交中保持谨慎与Self-protection以避免Being rejected

object_relations.object_representation: 他人是评判者与拒绝者，对自己not耐烦

object_relations.self_representation: 需要他人肯定才能感到有价值的依赖者
object_relations.object_representation: 朋友是权威的认可给予者，但可能厌烦和疏远

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When guided in counseling or conversation to focus on past successful projects and refute the failure narrative with positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认为成功只是侥幸，not足以证明自己有能力（将积极证据视为not可靠）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone flat, emphasizes words such as 'luck', 'coincidence', downplaying the meaning of success, returning to failure cases to explain.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当朋友或咨询师对其反复寻求肯定表现出not耐烦或建议其更信任自己时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者将他人的not耐烦理解为“我是问题所在”，并将负面评价内化到自我
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气自责、降低自我价值感，use“It is all my fault”“我not配”的表述，减少表达自己的需求。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在社交场合中对方沉默或互动减少时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认定他人not愿与自己交谈、在看低自己（读心并将负面感受归于他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Speaking in a manner of guessing others' negative thoughts, with a cautious and distant tone, reducing proactive in-depth communication.

manifestations: 从童年起在社交场合长期感到羞怯与孤立
离婚后Loneliness感加剧，难以建立新的人际连接
In work and community activities, feels avoided by people; hard to interact with colleagues and parents
与朋友相处时难以敞开表达Loneliness与羞怯
outcomes: 寻求他人验证导致Relationship tension

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 担心给朋友带来负担而not愿敞开
频繁寻求他人对工作的认可以缓解not安
在社交互动中小心翼翼、减少深入交流

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 在社交场合将他人的沉默理解为not愿与自己交谈或看低自己
把自我羞怯与not被接纳的感受归因于他人的态度

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Views career success or failure as an absolute black-and-white standard (either success or failure)
把外在的业绩结果内化为自我价值的唯一依据

positive_force: 具备一定职业稳定性（工作表现not yet被直接影响）
仍有少数亲密朋友可提供一定支持
愿意尝试行为实验，持开放与探索态度
在社交场合能够推动自己主动开启对话
negative_force: 自我价值与项目成败高度捆绑
非黑即白思维主导成功/失败评估
过度寻求外部认可，易引发Interpersonal tension
negate积极结果、聚焦失败证据
社交读心与个人化倾向，预设他人not愿交流

target_behavior.behavior: 回避或拖延启动新项目
antecedent: 面对新项目时Anticipation可能失败
target_behavior.core_reason: 将项目结果与自我价值绝对绑定，非黑即白地解读成败；失败被视为个人整体not够好
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与负面评价，以降低Anxiety与羞愧
target_behavior.consequence: 动机显著下降、Sleep affected、Career development受阻

target_behavior.behavior: 反复向朋友寻求对工作的认可与安慰
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth depends on external affirmation, lacking stability of internal self-evaluation
target_behavior.function: 获得安慰与短暂的安全感，稳定自我价值
target_behavior.consequence: 朋友产生not耐烦，Interpersonal tension，进一步加剧Loneliness感

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交场合减少深入交流或提前退出（Social avoidance）
antecedent: 工作与社区活动中的互动情境
离婚后社交压力与not被理解的担心
target_behavior.core_reason: 羞怯与“读心术”倾向导致对Being rejected的预测与个人化解释
target_behavior.function: 避免Being rejected或尴尬，降低Social anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Loneliness与隔离感增加，难以建立新的连接与维持友谊
